jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The organization is seeking an experienced Chief Information Officer
to lead its enterprise technology and business systems. This full-time role is based in the United States.

Inheriting an established operational foundation supported by significant recent investments, the Chief Information Officer will elevate organizational capacity across a complex operational environment characterized by consultative sales, physical and digital fulfillment, and sophisticated revenue recognition.

Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer and collaborating closely with the Chief Operating Officer on enterprise-wide initiatives, the Chief Information Officer leads a 175-person organization comprising 75 full-time employees alongside vendor partners and contractors, with an annual operating budget exceeding $45 million.

Key Responsibilities

Own the strategy, modernization, and optimization of the core technology stack—including Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, and HubSpot—and an application portfolio of more than 400 systems, managing costs and reducing technical debt.
Staff, activate, and direct the internal AI Transformation team to securely integrate artificial intelligence and low-code/no-code solutions into enterprise workflows.
Oversee the internal AI productivity roadmap and manage deployments of tools such as Glean, Claude, and Salesforce Agentforce, supporting vibe-coding for non-technical employees alongside robust governance frameworks that ensure speed and safety.
Partner with Finance and external auditors to preserve transaction integrity, mature General IT Controls (GITC), and support SOC and financial audit readiness.
Direct technology investments toward functional areas including People, Marketing, and Product-facing systems while maintaining rigorous financial controls.
Direct a 175-person blended workforce, completing the planned operational evolution toward distinct strategic and delivery functions to enable structured governance and agile execution.
Reduce governance overhead, foster cross-functional accountability, and empower teams to implement pragmatic solutions efficiently.
Transform the Business Systems organization into a proactive, consultative partner for functional leaders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Finance, Supply Chain, and Product.
Collaborate with the Data organization to assess and implement improvements in cross-functional operations and alignment.

Required Qualifications

Proven executive leadership experience heading an IT or Business Systems organization of 50 or more individuals with substantial budget responsibility within a complex, multi-channel enterprise generating $300 million to $1 billion or more in revenue.
Demonstrated track record of driving enterprise AI adoption beyond the pilot phase, deploying tools with measurable workforce uptake, establishing effective governance, and standing up or scaling an enablement team that empowers non-technical teams with low-code/no-code capabilities.
Extensive enterprise systems depth, including ownership of modern CRM, ERP, and HRIS platforms and a large application portfolio, with documented outcomes in system simplification, financial discipline, and strategic resource allocation.
Deep expertise partnering with Chief Financial Officers and external auditors on revenue recognition, SOC, SOX, and GITC frameworks, with the credibility to present on internal controls and organizational maturity to Board audit and risk committees.
Documented success in evaluating and elevating talent, structuring distinct strategic and operational delivery teams, decreasing reliance on external vendors, and attracting high-performing technology professionals.

Preferred Qualifications

Leadership experience within an enterprise that combines physical logistics or fulfillment operations with digital SaaS delivery models.

Leadership Competencies

Proactive orientation toward internal customer success, prioritizing speed and pragmatic interim solutions over bureaucratic process.
Demonstrated ability to balance rigorous governance standards with agile operational execution.
Strong cross-functional facilitation skills, focused on designing integrated workflows across departments rather than isolated systems.
Executive presence appropriate for regular interaction with senior leadership and the Board of Directors.
Commitment to mission-oriented environments and energized by fast-paced organizational growth.

Employment Conditions and Notices

Selected candidates must successfully complete a background check prior to employment.
Where required by state or local laws and applicable policies, candidates may be required to provide additional documentation, such as proof of vaccination, or submit to enhanced background screening, including fingerprinting.
The organization is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made based on qualifications and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.
Reasonable accommodations are provided for qualified individuals with disabilities, including disabled veterans, throughout the application and hiring process.
The hiring organization participates in E-Verify.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The organization is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to lead its end-to-end technology organization, spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate and platform cybersecurity.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and partnering with executive leadership, this executive provides comprehensive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer reports directly to this role.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Drive overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for the organization's core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget and drive cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner with executive leadership to transition new products from beta to market launch while actively managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.
Oversee day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning and deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures while enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on (SSO), and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close alignment with organizational leadership to ensure high uptime and integration security.
Direct organization-wide information security initiatives across corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
Establish and audit enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
Enforce compliance and audit readiness—including SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries—in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.
Evaluate alpha projects and proofs of concept across departments, guiding execution to integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, scalable services.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across corporate SaaS applications.
Serve as direct manager to the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), establishing shared goals and aligning product, engineering, and data strategies with enterprise infrastructure and security standards.
Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.
Build, mentor, and scale a service-oriented IT and security team aligned with organizational growth objectives.
Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for staff.

Qualifications

12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including roles such as Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or Chief Technology Officer.
Demonstrated experience managing enterprise IT and information security stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, including SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
Proven track record of building and leading technical teams across a broad range of expertise.
Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through periods of organizational growth.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executive leadership, and Board members.

Compensation and Benefits

Annual salary: $220,000 to $230,000,
commensurate with experience.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options.
403(b) retirement plan with an employer match.
Paid vacation, paid holidays, and paid sick leave.
Paid parental leave.
Professional development and education reimbursement assistance.
Monthly technology and wellness stipend.

Additional Information

Essential duties reflect the primary functions assigned to this role and may be adjusted or reassigned at any time.
Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions, absent undue hardship.
The organization maintains a zero-tolerance policy regarding abuse and inappropriate behavior.

jobs.title: Vice President of Technology
jobs.description:
Company Description

Matrixport-NY is a technology-driven financial services company focused on delivering secure, scalable, and innovative digital asset solutions. The organization combines advanced information technology with rigorous risk management to support institutional and enterprise clients. Matrixport-NY emphasizes reliability, performance, and compliance, creating technology platforms that enable efficient trading, custody, and asset management. Team members collaborate across functions and geographies in a remote-first environment, working with modern tools and methodologies to drive continuous improvement and growth.

Role Description

The Vice President of Technology is a full-time, remote leadership role responsible for setting and executing the technology vision for Matrixport-NY. This role oversees architecture, engineering, infrastructure, and security teams to ensure platforms are stable, scalable, and aligned with business objectives. Day-to-day responsibilities include defining IT strategy, prioritizing and managing technology projects, guiding system design and implementation, and coordinating with product, operations, and compliance teams. The Vice President of Technology reviews performance metrics, manages budgets and vendor relationships, and drives continuous improvement in development practices, reliability, and security. This role also mentors technology leaders, supports talent development, and fosters a culture of collaboration, accountability, and innovation.

Qualifications

Strong analytical skills to interpret complex data, assess technology performance, and support informed decision-making.
Robust Information Technology expertise, including systems architecture, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and enterprise IT operations.
Demonstrated experience in IT strategy and strategic planning to align technology roadmaps with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
Proven project management capabilities to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage timelines and budgets, and deliver high-impact technology solutions.
Extensive leadership experience overseeing engineering or IT teams, with a track record of building and scaling high-performing, diverse teams.
Background in financial services, fintech, or digital assets is highly beneficial, including familiarity with security, compliance, and risk frameworks.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical groups.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, cloud certifications) are a plus.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Director of Information Technology
will oversee the internal technology estate end to end and lead the team responsible for running it. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, this full-time role based in the United States covers identity, endpoints, networking, collaboration, service management, and the internal artificial intelligence platform across a distributed, remote-first organization.

This position is designed for a leader experienced in building and scaling internal technology through periods of rapid growth, possessing the capability to construct a multi-year roadmap while maintaining the ability to resolve operational issues directly. The role collaborates closely with Security, Engineering, Finance, and Human Resources leadership while managing vendor and managed service provider relationships.

Key Responsibilities

Build and execute a multi-year internal technology roadmap across identity, endpoints, networking, collaboration, and service management.
Tie technology investments directly to business outcomes with defined success measures.
Define internal delivery models versus services managed through partners and managed service providers.
Establish IT governance, operating standards, architecture reviews, and change management.
Design the internal IT function, build business cases for headcount, and hire and develop team members.
Mentor the team and establish clear ownership, on-call schedules, and escalation models.
Build and maintain the internal service catalog and associated service level agreements.
Own internal AI tool use case development, rollout, training, and adoption measurement.
Partner with the organization's AI practice so internal usage directly informs client-facing delivery.
Apply financial engineering to the internal AI estate by developing unit-cost models, forecasting consumption, negotiating commitments and reserved capacity, and holding AI expenditures accountable to measured productivity gains.
Own endpoint management, configuration baselines, patching, and hardware lifecycles using Intune or equivalent systems.
Manage the Microsoft 365 collaboration environment, including Teams, SharePoint, and Exchange governance.
Define and enforce device posture requirements for a remote-first workforce.
Direct internal network architecture, remote access, and secure connectivity models.
Manage the internal cloud and hosting footprint, including capacity, cost, and resilience.
Direct backup, recovery, and business continuity for internal systems with tested recovery objectives.
Establish and mature IT service management across intake, incident, problem, request, and change processes.
Publish operational metrics and systematically eliminate key sources of employee workflow friction.
Oversee the onboarding and offboarding technology experience in partnership with Human Resources.
Manage the internal IT budget, financial forecasts, and software licensing positions.
Rationalize the SaaS estate and direct renewals, contract negotiations, and vendor terms.
Hold external partners and managed service providers accountable to defined service levels.
Partner with security leadership to execute the IT components of the broader security program.
Support SOC 2 and ISO audit readiness, including control operation and evidence collection.
Own vulnerability management and remediation across internal systems and endpoints.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of information technology experience, including proven experience leading teams or owning a technology function.
Demonstrated experience building and scaling internal IT within a distributed or remote-first company during periods of rapid growth.
Experience presenting technology strategy, investment recommendations, operational risks, and performance metrics to executive leadership.
Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, endpoint management (Intune or equivalent), and SaaS administration at scale.
Demonstrated ownership of internal AI adoption and governance, including policy creation, data handling, and change management.
Strong security fluency, with the ability to partner credibly with executive security leadership and translate technical risk into business terms.
Proven experience supporting SOC 2, ISO, or related regulated compliance and audit requirements.
Experience managing IT budgets and negotiating contracts with vendors and managed service providers.
Ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both executive and technical audiences, in writing and in person.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating within a solutions provider, managed service provider (MSP), or technology consulting environment.
Relevant industry certifications, such as ITIL, Microsoft certifications, CISSP, CISM, PMP, or equivalent credentials.

Compensation and Benefits

Full-time employment status.
Discretionary incentive compensation and bonus opportunities based on individual and organizational performance.
Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) retirement plan with an employer match.
Flexible time off, paid holidays, and paid sick leave.
Short-term and long-term disability insurance.
Life insurance.
Paid parental leave.

Employment Notices

The organization is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. Qualified candidates are considered without regard to any legally protected status. This role is subject to applicable employment laws based on work location. In compliance with pay transparency laws, final compensation is determined based on experience, skills, and location. The organization participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility and provides reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process upon request.

The enterprise business applications portfolio includes internal systems supporting People, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Procurement, and Operations. jobs.title: Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The hiring organization is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
to lead the technology capabilities that keep digital products, cloud platforms, and internal teams secure, reliable, and productive.

This role oversees cloud infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, bot mitigation, corporate IT, and helpdesk support, while providing architectural leadership across cloud platforms, networking, identity, observability, and operational tooling. This position spans both internal employee technology and the production infrastructure supporting high-traffic, customer-facing applications.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, SRE, production operations, corporate IT, helpdesk, and bot mitigation, establishing ownership, operational standards, service-level objectives (SLOs), escalation procedures, and performance metrics.
Develop managers, technical leads, and IT staff through coaching, career development, and building a culture of accountability, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement.
Build quarterly and annual infrastructure roadmaps aligned with business priorities, growth, security, reliability, and cost, partnering with engineering, product, data, marketing, finance, HR, legal, and executive leadership.
Own the reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure, primarily within AWS.
Provide architectural leadership across cloud services, applications, APIs, networking, identity, databases, storage, observability, and integrations while establishing architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and technical review processes.
Partner with engineering to improve deployment safety, performance, and readiness, driving automation, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
Lead capacity planning for growth and demand spikes, eliminating single points of failure, undocumented systems, manual processes, and single-source dependencies.
Ensure production and nonproduction environments are properly separated, secured, and monitored, reviewing new systems for architectural fit, supportability, security, and total cost of ownership.
Establish and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), SLOs, availability targets, and error-budget practices for critical systems.
Improve observability through centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, application performance monitoring (APM), and actionable alerting.
Lead major incident management, coordination, executive communication, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking to improve mean time to detect, respond, and recover.
Develop and test backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, and establish sustainable on-call practices.
Own strategy and tooling for bot mitigation, scraping protection, automated abuse prevention, and traffic-quality management using technologies such as Cloudflare, DataDome, web application firewalls (WAFs), rate limiting, CAPTCHA alternatives, and device fingerprinting.
Partner with cross-functional teams to distinguish malicious automation from legitimate customers, search engines, partners, and approved AI crawlers, establishing monitoring and response procedures.
Oversee internal IT services and helpdesk support, establishing service-level expectations for response times, resolution times, user satisfaction, and backlog reduction.
Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, equipment provisioning, access management, asset recovery, and device inventory.
Standardize endpoint configuration, encryption, patching, and endpoint detection across laptops, collaboration platforms, productivity software, and telecom services.
Establish consistent identity and access management practices across corporate and production systems, implementing role-based access, least privilege, multi-factor authentication (MFA), periodic access reviews, and secure administrative account handling.
Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, audits, vendor reviews, incident readiness, and applicable privacy requirements in partnership with legal and security teams.
Manage infrastructure, security, IT, telecom, monitoring, and support vendors, handling evaluations, contract reviews, renewals, licensing, service level agreements (SLAs), and budget management.
Improve cloud cost visibility through tagging, allocation, forecasting, tool consolidation, and contract optimization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, IT operations, or related disciplines.
5+ years of experience leading engineering or technology teams, including managing managers or technical leads.
Demonstrated experience operating high-traffic, customer-facing platforms in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, security, observability, databases, APIs, storage, and distributed systems.
Experience managing production availability, incident response, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience managing corporate IT, employee support, endpoint management, software licensing, and access provisioning.
Experience establishing operational metrics, SLOs, and support standards.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, contracts, departmental budgets, and cloud costs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, architecture, and tradeoffs to executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Cloudflare, DataDome, or comparable bot-management and web application protection platforms, including leading bot mitigation or traffic-quality programs.
Experience with AWS services, containerized environments, infrastructure as code, centralized logging, and APM tools (such as AppDynamics).
Experience supporting large-scale consumer subscription, public-record, data-as-a-service, advertising, or ecommerce platforms.
Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure, transitioning systems from external vendors, and consolidating cloud accounts or IT services.
Familiarity with privacy requirements and secure handling of sensitive consumer data.
Experience building or maturing SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering functions.

Measures of Success

Improved availability, performance, and stability of customer-facing platforms.
Reduced impact and infrastructure costs associated with bots, scraping, and automated abuse.
Faster incident detection, response, and recovery, alongside a reduction in recurring incidents.
Enhanced observability with reduced alert noise, validated disaster recovery capabilities, and optimized cloud spend.
Consistent helpdesk performance, reliable onboarding and offboarding, and robust endpoint security and asset tracking.
Strong architecture governance, reduced dependency on undocumented systems or vendors, and demonstrated team development.

Compensation and Benefits

Annual base salary: $170,000 - $180,000

Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision insurance
Life insurance
Retirement benefits with employer match
